system.effect: Gain a +1 Condition bonus to Guile checks to imitate a voice you have heard clearly for at least 1 minute. A listener who knows the speaker may still notice inconsistencies; this does not change your appearance or grant a language.
system.description: Your voice can reproduce a remembered cadence with unsettling precision.
system.automation: [EFFECT CHECK: 1 condition, guile; IF: CLAIM(imitate a voice you have heard clearly for at least 1 minute)]
